plugins.name: Playhub Artworks
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: The right artwork for every game in your library.
plugins.longDescription:
Playhub Artworks brings artwork management into Big Picture with a controller-first experience: search, choose, and apply covers, banners, heroes, logos, and icons without returning to the desktop.

## What it does
• Searches for artwork across SteamGridDB, IGDB, PlayStation Store, Nintendo eShop, Xbox, AlphaCoders, iiDB, and IGN.
• Remembers your filters and most recently used source separately for each artwork type.
• Creates Perfect Heroes and Perfect Banners by blending a background and logo, with adjustable position, scale, opacity, and shadow.
• Lets you leave the logo out of the composition when you only want the background.
• Positions and resizes game logos just like Steam.
• Displays square covers throughout the library and across every Home shelf, including Steam banners.
• Fills in missing artwork for your entire library in the background.

## Note
• Searches using SteamGridDB require a personal API key, which is stored only on your PC.

plugins.name: Launch Curtain
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: A direct gateway into the world of every game.
plugins.longDescription:
Launch Curtain turns starting a PC game into a console-like experience. When you launch a game from Steam Big Picture, a full-screen loading curtain hides desktop flashes, launchers, and misplaced windows, keeping the game's logo front and center with a smooth fade. This plugin is exclusive to Windows.

## What it does
• Shows a customizable curtain as soon as a game launches.
• Lets you place and resize the logo, choose the background and its opacity, and optionally add an animated zoom to the logo.
• Hides automatically when the game window reaches fullscreen, or after a safety timeout.
• Can be dismissed with ESC or the Back/Close button on common controllers.

## Customization
• You can use your own logo (PNG, JPG, WebP, or BMP) instead of the Playhub logo when the game has no logo available.
• You can adjust how long Launch Curtain remains visible after the game is ready.

plugins.name: Now Playing
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: Your favorite songs, always within reach.
plugins.longDescription:
Now Playing is your console-style music companion, bringing the active Windows media session into Steam's Quick Access Menu with album art, track details, and controls always within gamepad reach.

## What it does
• Shows the active Windows media session in the Quick Access Menu.
• Displays the title, artist, album art, and track progress.
• Provides play/pause, previous, next, shuffle, and repeat controls whenever the player makes them available.
• Opens popular music apps in an instant: Spotify, TIDAL, Apple Music, Deezer, Amazon Music, and SoundCloud.
• Includes a full-screen Now Playing view with a visualizer.
• Uses a dedicated Windows helper to read media sessions.

plugins.name: Playhub Metadata
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: Details, artwork, and achievements for your games.
plugins.longDescription:
Playhub Metadata gives your Big Picture library a richer, more polished, console-like feel, especially for non-Steam games such as external PC titles, Game Pass games, Xbox apps, and emulators. It adds metadata, community images and videos, categories, and even achievements.

## Metadata and images
• Automatically finds missing game metadata.
• Adds descriptions, developers, publishers, release dates, ratings, and information panels.
• Adds community screenshots and media when available.
• Lets you edit each game's metadata manually.

## Achievements
• Displays achievements for non-Steam games inside Big Picture.
• Supports RetroAchievements for ROMs and emulators.
• Supports Xbox, Game Pass, and Microsoft Store achievements through OpenXBL (games must be imported through Playhub's Import Games tab).
• Lets you choose the source for each game: Auto, RetroAchievements, Xbox, or Disabled.
• Offers flexible hourly, daily, weekly, per-session, or manual caching to limit API calls.

## Note
• These do not become native Steam achievements; they are displayed only inside Big Picture.

plugins.name: Quick Settings
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: The settings that matter, always within reach.
plugins.longDescription:
Quick Settings brings essential Windows controls into Steam Big Picture through a lightweight local agent started by the plugin. Everything you need remains accessible from the Quick Access Menu, without returning to the desktop.

## Available controls
• Device volume.
• Microphone volume.
• Screen dimmer overlay.
• Audio output and microphone input selectors.
• HDR toggle with a 10-second confirmation.
• HDR status read directly from Windows (DisplayConfig / Advanced Color) instead of relying on a state saved by the plugin.

plugins.name: Shortcuts
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: Arrange Steam, Decky and your favourite plugin tabs from one place.
plugins.longDescription:
Shortcuts gives you one controller-friendly place to arrange Steam's native Quick Access Menu tabs, Decky and compatible plugin shortcuts. Changes appear immediately on the Steam Home screen and while playing.

## What it does
• Reorders Steam's native QAM tabs, Decky and compatible custom tabs.
• Turns loaded Decky plugin panels into independent shortcuts.
• Keeps every plugin's original Decky entry available.
• Lets you use the original icon or choose from the included Tabler icons.
• Saves icon and tab choices across Steam and Shortcuts restarts.
• Restores temporarily unavailable plugins when they return.

## Note
• It uses guarded integration with Steam and Decky's internal QAM tab registry because no public API currently covers independent top-level tabs and their ordering. A future Steam or Decky update may require an adjustment.

plugins.name: Playhub Notifications
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: More beautiful, clearer, and more personal notifications.
plugins.longDescription:
Playhub Notifications replaces Steam's visible notification popups and sounds with animated themes designed for Big Picture, while leaving the native notification history intact.

## What it does
• Offers seven dedicated themes: Xbox Console, PlayStation, GOG Galaxy, Epic Games Launcher, Nintendo, Android, and Playhub.
• Customizes achievements, messages, invitations, downloads, screenshots, controllers, alerts, system notifications, and community notifications.
• Uses the real achievement artwork supplied by Steam when available.
• Lets you choose notification position, duration, and volume, with a range from 0% to 200%.
• Shows system volume through an overlay matched to the selected theme.
• Includes previews for testing every notification type directly from the Quick Access Menu.

## Notes
• Only the visible popup and its sound are replaced; Steam's original notification history remains available.
• The overlay does not take focus or intercept controller, keyboard, or mouse input while you play.

plugins.name: ThemeDeck
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: Soundtracks, heard the way they deserve.
plugins.longDescription:
ThemeDeck gives your library a soundtrack. It plays music when you open a game page in Gaming Mode, with optional ambient music for the interface and a separate track for the Store. This Windows-focused fork remains named ThemeDeck inside Decky.

## What it does
• Plays a custom track when you open a game's detail page.
• Lets you choose local audio files or search YouTube with yt-dlp.
• Downloads and assigns tracks from YouTube results, with a preview before confirmation.
• Supports per-game volume, start offset, and looping.
• Provides a global ambient track for non-game pages and a separate track for the Store.
• Stops the music when a game launches or is running.
• Can automatically find and assign missing tracks through YouTube searches.

## Notes
• It controls only its own audio and does not change the Windows system volume.
• The Windows release includes yt-dlp.exe to power search and downloads.
• The interface automatically follows the Steam/Decky language, with 11 languages supported.

plugins.name: TrailerHero
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: Your game trailers, always within gamepad reach.
plugins.longDescription:
TrailerHero gives Steam Big Picture the feel of a console dashboard. When you open a game page, it keeps the original artwork visible for three seconds, then smoothly fades a muted trailer into the same hero area, preferring Steam trailers and falling back to YouTube when needed.

## Main controls
• Enabled turns the effect on or off.
• Enable on home also plays trailers on the Big Picture library Home screen.
• Game page logo moves the game logo to the lower-left corner during the trailer and restores it when you leave.
• Automatic CRT applies a subtle CRT effect to low-resolution trailers.
• Source selects Auto, Steam, or YouTube for each game.
• Quality sets the preferred Steam and YouTube quality to 720p, 1080p, or 2160p.
• Steam video lets you choose any Steam video for the game from a menu, not only the featured trailer.
• Trim start / Trim end save a custom video cut for each game.
• Custom YouTube link saves a specific YouTube trailer; without one, automatic search favors 4K results and applies strict title matching.

## Notes
• It was created on and for Windows, although it should also work on Linux.
• It reads and adapts Big Picture interface elements, which Steam updates often, so some selectors may need adjustments over time.

plugins.name: News
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: The stories that matter, gathered in one place.
plugins.longDescription:
News brings your favorite sources to the Quick Access Menu and a comfortable full-screen newsstand designed for reading with a controller.

## What it does
• Collects RSS and Atom feeds without requiring an API key.
• Organizes sources and articles into categories.
• Shows headlines in the Quick Access Menu and a complete reading view in Big Picture.
• Includes a clean reader, search, and four-direction navigation.
• Keeps your configured sources and refreshes content without interrupting navigation.

plugins.name: Weather
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: Simple, unobtrusive weather in the Quick Access Menu.
plugins.longDescription:
Weather is a compact plugin that brings current conditions plus daily and hourly forecasts into the Quick Access Menu. It is designed for Big Picture and controller navigation, with a compact, resilient layout that prevents clipped text and overflow.

## What it does
• Shows current conditions, a five-day forecast, and the next 24 hours.
• Uses the Open-Meteo backend with no API key required.
• Supports metric and imperial units.
• Includes a dedicated settings view for searching by city or coordinates.
• Supports controller-friendly up, down, left, and right navigation.
• Uses a dark, minimal interface with subtle animated details.
• Detects the language automatically, with 11 languages supported.

plugins.name: Playhub Surround
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: Test your speakers, one channel at a time.
plugins.longDescription:
Playhub Surround is a compact tool for checking stereo, 5.1, and 7.1 speaker layouts. It presents a living-room-style map and plays synthesized test sounds inspired by classic video games. No copyrighted samples are used; every sound is generated live through the Web Audio API.

## What it does
• Shows a living-room-style speaker map.
• Supports stereo, 5.1, and 7.1 layouts.
• Plays synthesized test sounds inspired by classic video games.
• Generates every sound live with the Web Audio API, without protected samples.
• Includes a sequential channel test, volume control, and sound presets.
• Supports controller navigation across the layout, map, presets, volume, and test button.
• Automatically follows the Steam language, with 11 languages supported.

## Notes
• It works on Windows; Linux has not been tested.
• Multichannel playback depends on Steam/Chromium and the selected output device. If the system exposes only two channels, rear, center, and LFE tests may be downmixed.

plugins.name: Proton VPN
plugins.author: LoZazaMastro
plugins.shortDescription: Your VPN, without leaving Gaming Mode.
plugins.longDescription:
Proton VPN brings the essential controls of the Windows client into the Quick Access Menu, so you can protect or change your connection without returning to the desktop.

## What it does
• Shows the actual VPN connection status.
• Connects and disconnects Proton VPN from the Quick Access Menu.
• Lets you choose an available location.
• Keeps navigation simple and controller-friendly.

## Note
• Requires the official Proton VPN app for Windows to be installed and configured.
